title: [Medtronic] Automation-triggered profile % changes cause lost pump connections
symptom: Automation rules that change the profile % can trigger MDT pump connection failures that persist until AAPS and RL are restarted. The issue occurs occasionally when rules trigger, and is more frequent when rules are enabled. Deleting the app cache resolves the problem for a week+, while restarting the phone/Orangelink only temporarily resolves it.
cause: The thread does not definitively identify a root cause. It speculates that it might be a combination of profile change, microbolus, and temp basal, but no conclusive cause is established.
fix: The issue was resolved by testing on AAPS 3.0 B3-B5 and AAPS 2.8.2.10 dev build 2021-11-11, where the problem could no longer be replicated. The thread also notes that deleting the app cache solves the problem for a week+, but this is a workaround, not a permanent fix.
evidence_quote: Tested AAPS 2.8.2.10 dev build 2021-11-11 11:40am on an S7 running Android 11 (Pixel Experience) connecting to an MDT 554 via an Orangelink and am no longer able to replicate this. Closing.
